decisionsTitle: The desk records a runner's spoken wish to appear by name: «Anonim» → «Cu nume» asked first, recorded as theirs with who recorded it, the person emailed at once with a one-tap undo (amending §143, §910, §1004)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20, the day before the race, of the desk's eye (§1004):** «dacă cineva are semnul ăsta de „Anonim” trebuie să îl pot schimba în „Cu nume” la click, dar cu acordul lor» — if someone wears the «Anonim» sign, I must be able to turn it into «Cu nume» with a click, but with their agreement. Until now the eye only said the public wish; the list's tick was the person's alone — given on the form, changed from their own three doors (`list-consent.ts`: the confirmation email's `LIST_CONSENT` link, «Înscrierile mele», the registration's manage page) or by writing to the club (§143) — and BR-REQ-072-01 criterion 7 said that «no staff member ticks it for a runner» (§808). At the desk the runner stands in front of a volunteer and says it.

**Decision.**

- **The eye becomes a press for the person's own wish.** On a desk row that is not over, on an open desk, whose address was confirmed, the eye «Anonim» / «Cu nume» is a button for every role that works the desk (`roles.ts#canRecordListWishAtDesk`, written as `canWorkTheDesk`; never a member): the same words and the same eye, outlined (`siteNamed` / `siteAnonymous` in `action-icons.ts`), 44 pixels. It records the person's wish **the other way**: «Anonim» (`list_opt_out = true`) → «Cu nume», «Cu nume» → «Anonim». It asks first (`ConfirmDialog`, «Anulează» focused, the house's mail line saying the email): «{name} ți-a spus acum că vrea să apară cu numele pe lista participanților și în clasament?» — «Numele apare pe site; persoana primește un email și poate retrage oricând.» — «Da, a spus — afișează pe site»; the way back «{name} a cerut să nu mai apară cu numele?» — «Da — ascunde numele», «Nu pleacă niciun email». For a minor the parent or guardian the kit goes to (§108) is the one who answers, and the question names them. The form posts the wish (`listed`), never a flip, so a stale row's second press lands on the same state. Anywhere else — a closed desk, a row that is over, an address never confirmed, no role — the chip as it was (§1004).
- **The server records it as the person's** (`registrations/desk-list-wish.ts#recordListWishAtDesk`, from `admin/registrations/actions.ts#recordListWishAtDeskAction`, an email press; the role asserted by the action and again by the service, BR-REQ-060-01; a GET never writes). One transaction with the registration's row locked: the person's own `list_opt_out`, written as their own doors write it (`list-consent.ts#listChoiceColumns`: hiding takes the socials with it, §500); showing, on a registration whose privacy notice predates the first that described the results while §879's question is put (the notice in force names `{{resultsNameAsk}}` and `{{results}}`, a race), also the results' name the person's own page would set — `results_name_consent`, `results_consent_version` the notice in force in the registration's language — unless they already hold a yes that counts; and **one** audit row, `registration.list_consent_changed`, the action the person's own doors write, `{ from, to, via: "DESK" }` (and `resultsNameConsent`, `noticeVersion` when the results' yes came with it), with the staff member who recorded it as the actor (`actorStaffUserId`) — never the person's name. The registration's timeline says it in words: «Dorința spusă la masă, înregistrată de echipă: apare cu numele pe site» (… «și în clasament», … «nu mai apare cu numele pe site»), followed by the colleague's name. The same wish twice writes nothing, emails nobody and records no row.
- **The person is told at once, showing only** (`LIST_CONSENT_RECORDED`, a new message type, migration `0224`, the enum's value alone): one email to the registration's address in its language, both halves as every email of the house — «La masa de ridicare a numerelor de la {event} ai cerut să apari cu numele pe lista participanților și în clasament.» (for a minor, to the parent or guardian, «ai cerut ca {name} să apară…»), then the platform's line «Dacă nu e așa, apasă butonul de mai jos și numele nu mai apare pe site…», whoever rewrote the words, and its one button «Nu vreau să apar pe lista de participanți & rezultate»: a `LIST_CONSENT` link minted at the send — the confirmation's own one-tap switch, superseding the older link (§12.8) — whose page takes the name off in one press. So the club holds the record and the person holds the undo. The renderer withdraws it, and the club's copy beside it, when by the send the name is off the list again or the registration is over or erased. The confirmations' road, the participant's own mail (a club copy as every participant message has), no «Nu mai pot ajunge» — it is about the name, sent to somebody standing at the desk. Its sample and its words are on «Emailuri» with the house's `email-copy` fields (`{eventTitle}`). Hiding emails nobody: taking a name off needs no proof.
- **The club's hide stands** (§910, §948). A name an Administrator hid with «Apare pe site» unticked stays hidden: the eye still says «Anonim», a line under it says «Ascuns de club („Apare pe site” debifat). Persoana vrea cu nume.» (or «… anonim.»), and the press changes the person's own wish and nothing else (`admin-repository.ts#HIDDEN_BY_CLUB`, read as one fact, never the mark it comes from — `ambassador-never-leaves.test.ts` holds).
- **Refused, nothing written:** a registration that is over (`LIST_WISH_OVER`); one whose address was never confirmed (`LIST_WISH_ADDRESS_UNCONFIRMED`) — the email would be the one message this platform sends to an address nobody vouched for besides the confirmation itself (`event-notices.ts`'s rule), so «Confirmă pe hârtie» vouches for it first and the eye is a press after it; an event completed or cancelled, whose desk is closed (`LIST_WISH_DESK_CLOSED`, as a check-in is).
- **The rules say it.** CLAUDE.md's public-list row and staff row, `AGENTS.md` §10.10, §15.11 (the desk's verbs) and §16.3 (the message type): a desk role may record a runner's spoken wish to appear by name — asked first, recorded as theirs with who recorded it, the person emailed at once with a one-tap undo — and otherwise no staff member ticks it. BR-REQ-072-01 criterion 7 is amended the same way. The privacy notice's **template** gains one sentence in section 4, both languages: the wish to appear by name may also be told to the organizers at the race-number desk, who record it (who and when is kept), the person emailed at once with the link to withdraw it. Nothing in force changes until the club approves a version made from the template in «Documente legale» (§29, §639); no text was approved or seeded.
- **The words**, ≤200 characters each in both catalogues: `Admin.desk.siteWish.*`, the toasts and banners `listWish*`, `Admin.errors.LIST_WISH_*`, the trail's `auditListWish.*`, the email's `types`/`when`/`whenShort`/`whenMore` and its cause; one step in the desk's own how-to and a task «Vrea să apară cu numele, sau nu mai vrea» in the guide's «Ziua cursei».

**Refused.**

- **A tick the staff decide.** The press records what the person said, the question makes the colleague confirm they said it now, and the email puts the undo in their hands; a staff «Apare pe site» that shows a name stays refused (§910).
- **Recording it without telling the person**, or telling them on the way back: the email is the safeguard of a wish written down by somebody else; hiding needs none.
- **Emailing an address never confirmed** — refused instead, with «Confirmă pe hârtie» as the way.
- **Withdrawing the results' yes when hiding:** the person's own doors do not, and the results name a runner only while the list's tick is on (§808).
- **A second audit row for the results' yes:** one row, the list's, which says the results came with it.
- **A column, a table or a new token purpose:** the wish is `list_opt_out`, the recorder is the audit row's actor, the undo is the `LIST_CONSENT` link; the migration adds the enum's one value.
changelogLine: - **«Anonim» → «Cu nume» at the desk, on the runner's word** — the desk row's eye is a button for every desk role: it asks first whether the person just said they want their name on the participant list and in the results, records it as theirs with who recorded it, and emails them at once with a one-tap way back; «Cu nume» → «Anonim» the same way, with no email; a name the club hid stays hidden. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the race-day desk, when a desk role presses a runner's eye «Anonim» and confirms the question naming the person, then the person's own `list_opt_out` becomes false as their own doors set it, one `registration.list_consent_changed` audit row records `{ from, to, via: "DESK" }` with the staff member as the actor and never the name, and one `LIST_CONSENT_RECORDED` email is queued to the registration's address carrying the `LIST_CONSENT` link that takes the name off in one press; «Cu nume» → «Anonim» the same way, audited, with no email; the same wish twice writes nothing; a member is refused at the action and the service, and a cancelled or expired row, an address never confirmed and an event completed or cancelled are refused, nothing written; a name the Administrator hid with «Apare pe site» stays hidden (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/desk-list-wish.test.ts`, `db/list-consent-recorded-migration.test.ts`, unit `staff/list-wish-role.test.ts`.

Given the platform's privacy notice template, when its section 4 is read, then the public list's paragraph says in both languages that the wish to appear by name may also be told to the organizers at the race-number desk, who record it, who and when kept, the person emailed at once with the link to withdraw it at any time; no version is approved or seeded by it (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `legal-documents/privacy-desk-list-wish.test.ts`.

Amends criterion 7 («no staff member ticks it for a runner»): at the race-day desk a desk role records the runner's own spoken wish to appear by name — asked first, recorded as theirs with who recorded it, the person emailed at once with a one-tap undo — and, for a registration under a notice older than the first that described the results while criterion 8's question is put, the yes criterion 9 records, in the same transaction and the same one audit row (`resultsNameConsent`, `noticeVersion`); while the question is not put nothing of the results is set; otherwise no staff member ticks it (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/desk-list-wish.test.ts`.

Given a desk row that is not over, on an open desk, whose address was confirmed, when it is drawn for any desk role, then the eye «Cu nume» / «Anonim» is a 44-pixel button that asks first — naming the person (for a minor, the parent or guardian who answers), what follows and the email, «Anulează» focused — and posts the wish the other way; on a closed desk, a row that is over, an address never confirmed or with no role it is the chip as before; a name the club hid says «Ascuns de club» with the person's own wish under the eye (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `registrations/desk-list-wish.test.ts`, `registrations/one-bib-download.test.ts`, e2e `desk-list-wish.spec.ts`.

batchLine: desk: «Anonim» → «Cu nume» on the runner's word, recorded and emailed with a one-tap undo
